recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片幾乎全被中至大型未成熟細胞取代，核圓、染色質細緻、胞質深藍，胞質內可見多個清楚的圓形空泡（常沿核周或邊緣排列），並夾雜少數較成熟紅母細胞；以原始紅血球為主且胞質空泡，是純紅血球白血病的典型表現。
features: Near-total replacement by intermediate to large immature cells in sheets
Round central to slightly eccentric nuclei with finely granular chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with multiple sharply punched-out vacuoles, often at the cell periphery
Occasional binucleate forms and scattered more mature erythroblasts with condensed chromatin
Few granulocytic precursors in the field; red cells and smudged cells in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular and composed predominantly of sheets of intermediate to large immature cells with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin, occasional nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous discrete punched-out vacuoles. Scattered later-stage erythroblasts are present, while granulocytic precursors are sparse. Myeloblasts with granules or Auer rods are not seen. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia (pure erythroid leukemia), which requires erythroid predominance of at least 80% with at least 30% proerythroblasts; confirmation with E-cadherin, CD71 and glycophorin A, PAS staining and TP53 testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts show cytoplasmic blebbing and CD41/CD61 positivity and are negative for E-cadherin and glycophorin A.
Burkitt cells also have basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are smaller, CD19/CD10 positive B cells with MYC rearrangement and lipid-positive (oil red O) vacuoles.
Megaloblastic marrow shows a full spectrum of maturing erythroid cells with open chromatin, giant metamyelocytes and response to B12/folate, not a proerythroblast-predominant block.
Parvovirus shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions amid erythroid hypoplasia rather than sheets of vacuolated proerythroblasts.
